notes.title: Waves of Death v1.5 update
notes.notes:
For the update of «Waves of Death», each week and until July 4, 2021, WOD will offer 20 tee - shirts. Based on the ranking , Polygone Games will invite you as VIP. 

Following the constructive comments of the players we thank, Waves of Death evolves:
• Fewer levels to make the game denser and more fun 
• Gameplay with more options
• Addition of a graphics optimization tool
• Making the user manual available online
This update will delete your history in order to get you started on this new adventure.

notes.title: Waves of Death update
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,
We have taken your comments into account.

- Cloud save has been added.

- Leaderboards are now available.

- A 6 degrees of freedom mupliplayer mode is in the final QA process pipes right now, and will be available as an update soon.

After a new optimization round, we managed to lower the minimum requirements to : NVIDIA GTX 550 Ti with recommended resolution 1366 x 768 with shading settings set to low in options
